description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/ordering-online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelectedOrder" name="Selected order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ConfirmedPaymentStatus" name="Confirmed payment status"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingAddress" name="Shipping address"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Customer_Start" name="Begin shopping"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_Login" name="Log in to E-Shop" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Customer_WaitLogin" name="Wait for login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_LoginDecision" name="Was login successful?" default="Customer_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Customer_LoginFailedEnd" name="Shopping stops"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_CheckProducts" name="Check whether every product was selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_AllSelected" name="Were all products selected?" default="Customer_MoreProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_SubmitOrder" name="Submit selected order" messageRef="Message_SelectedOrder"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Customer_DetailsSplit" name="Enter payment and address details"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_SendPaymentData" name="Send payment data to bank" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Customer_WaitPayment" name="Wait for bank payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_SendPaymentStatus" name="Send confirmed payment status to E-Shop" messageRef="Message_ConfirmedPaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_BillingDecision" name="Is the billing address different?" default="Customer_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Customer_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Customer_BillingMerge" name="Continue after address entry"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Customer_SendAddress" name="Send shipping address to E-Shop" messageRef="Message_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Customer_DetailsJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Customer_End" name="Customer steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_1" sourceRef="Customer_Start" targetRef="Customer_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_2" sourceRef="Customer_Login" targetRef="Customer_WaitLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_3" sourceRef="Customer_WaitLogin" targetRef="Customer_LoginDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_LoginSuccess" name="Successful" sourceRef="Customer_LoginDecision" targetRef="Customer_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">loginSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_LoginFailure" name="Unsuccessful" sourceRef="Customer_LoginDecision" targetRef="Customer_LoginFailedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_6" sourceRef="Customer_SelectProduct" targetRef="Customer_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_7" sourceRef="Customer_AddToCart" targetRef="Customer_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_8" sourceRef="Customer_SaveProduct" targetRef="Customer_CheckProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_9" sourceRef="Customer_CheckProducts" targetRef="Customer_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_MoreProducts" name="More products to select" sourceRef="Customer_AllSelected" targetRef="Customer_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_ProductsComplete" name="All products selected" sourceRef="Customer_AllSelected" targetRef="Customer_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_12" sourceRef="Customer_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Customer_DetailsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_13" sourceRef="Customer_DetailsSplit" targetRef="Customer_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_14" sourceRef="Customer_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Customer_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_15" sourceRef="Customer_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Customer_WaitPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_16" sourceRef="Customer_WaitPayment" targetRef="Customer_SendPaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_17" sourceRef="Customer_SendPaymentStatus" targetRef="Customer_DetailsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_18" sourceRef="Customer_DetailsSplit" targetRef="Customer_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_19" sourceRef="Customer_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Customer_BillingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_BillingDifferent" name="Different address" sourceRef="Customer_BillingDecision" targetRef="Customer_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">billingAddressDifferent</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_BillingSame" name="Same address" sourceRef="Customer_BillingDecision" targetRef="Customer_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_22" sourceRef="Customer_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Customer_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_23" sourceRef="Customer_BillingMerge" targetRef="Customer_SendAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_24" sourceRef="Customer_SendAddress" targetRef="Customer_DetailsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Customer_Flow_25" sourceRef="Customer_DetailsJoin" targetRef="Customer_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shop" name="E-Shop order processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Shop_LoginStart" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Shop_LoginStartDefinition" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Shop_CheckCredentials" name="Check customer credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Shop_SendLoginConfirmation" name="Send login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Shop_LoginDecision" name="Were the credentials valid?" default="Shop_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Shop_LoginFailedEnd" name="Login unsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Shop_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive selected order" messageRef="Message_SelectedOrder"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Shop_PreparationSplit" name="Finish order and prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Shop_FinishOrderInitial" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Shop_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Shop_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Shop_PreparationJoin" name="Order preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Shop_DetailsSplit" name="Wait for address and payment steps"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Shop_ReceiveAddress" name="Receive shipping address" messageRef="Message_ShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Shop_ReceivePaymentStatus" name="Receive confirmed payment status" messageRef="Message_ConfirmedPaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Shop_DetailsJoin" name="Address and payment steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Shop_FinishOrderFinal" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Shop_OrderEnd" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_1" sourceRef="Shop_LoginStart" targetRef="Shop_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_2" sourceRef="Shop_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Shop_SendLoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_3" sourceRef="Shop_SendLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Shop_LoginDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_LoginSuccess" name="Successful" sourceRef="Shop_LoginDecision" targetRef="Shop_ReceiveOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">loginSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_LoginFailure" name="Unsuccessful" sourceRef="Shop_LoginDecision" targetRef="Shop_LoginFailedEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_6" sourceRef="Shop_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Shop_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_7" sourceRef="Shop_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Shop_FinishOrderInitial"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_8" sourceRef="Shop_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Shop_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_9" sourceRef="Shop_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Shop_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_10" sourceRef="Shop_FinishOrderInitial" targetRef="Shop_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_11" sourceRef="Shop_PreparePayment" targetRef="Shop_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_12" sourceRef="Shop_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Shop_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_13" sourceRef="Shop_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Shop_DetailsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_14" sourceRef="Shop_DetailsSplit" targetRef="Shop_ReceiveAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_15" sourceRef="Shop_DetailsSplit" targetRef="Shop_ReceivePaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_16" sourceRef="Shop_ReceiveAddress" targetRef="Shop_DetailsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_17" sourceRef="Shop_ReceivePaymentStatus" targetRef="Shop_DetailsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_18" sourceRef="Shop_DetailsJoin" targetRef="Shop_FinishOrderFinal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Shop_Flow_19" sourceRef="Shop_FinishOrderFinal" targetRef="Shop_OrderEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Bank payment confirmation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Bank_PaymentDataStart" name="Payment data received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Bank_PaymentDataStartDefinition" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Bank_ConfirmPayment" name="Confirm payment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Bank_SendConfirmation" name="Send payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Bank_End" name="Payment confirmation sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_1" sourceRef="Bank_PaymentDataStart" targetRef="Bank_ConfirmPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_2" sourceRef="Bank_ConfirmPayment" targetRef="Bank_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Bank_Flow_3" sourceRef="Bank_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Bank_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop" name="Ordering in an Online Shop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_Shop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginRequest" name="Login request" sourceRef="Customer_Login" targetRef="Shop_LoginStart"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginConfirmation" name="Login confirmation" sourceRef="Shop_SendLoginConfirmation" targetRef="Customer_WaitLogin"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelectedOrder" name="Selected order" sourceRef="Customer_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Shop_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="Customer_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Bank_PaymentDataStart"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation" sourceRef="Bank_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Customer_WaitPayment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ConfirmedPaymentStatus" name="Confirmed payment status" sourceRef="Customer_SendPaymentStatus" targetRef="Shop_ReceivePaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingAddress" name="Shipping address" sourceRef="Customer_SendAddress" targetRef="Shop_ReceiveAddress"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
